sn46.21:1.1: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn46.21:2.2: kittāvatā nu kho bhante bojjhaṅgāti vuccantīti.
sn46.21:2.3: sambodhāya saṃvattantīti kho bhikkhu tasmā bojjhaṅgāti vuccanti.
sn46.21:2.4: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ. pe.
sn46.21:2.5: upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn46.21:2.6: sambodhāya saṃvattantīti kho bhikkhu tasmā bojjhaṅgāti vuccantīti.
